title: 第9章 星辰觉醒第10章 暗流初现
content_zh:
阳光透过窗棂洒进房间，叶霄尘的目光在苏晚晴身上停留得有些久了。
系统追加的丰厚奖励让他的心情格外愉悦，嘴角不自觉扬起一抹意味深长的弧度。
叶龙和叶凡站在一旁，悄悄交换了一个眼神。
叶龙浓密的眉毛微微皱起，暗忖道：少主这眼神...莫不是看上这位妇人了？虽说年岁不小，但确实风韵犹存……
他的手不自觉地摸向腰间的刀柄，又赶紧放下。
叶凡则紧张地咽了咽口水，指节发白地捏着剑柄：若是少主有意，我是不是该...该主动帮忙安排？可这……
叶寒星的小手死死攥着补丁摞补丁的衣角，指节因用力而泛白。
他仰头望着叶霄尘含笑的侧脸，又看了看母亲恢复青春后愈发秀丽的面容，一颗心直往下沉：难道尘少爷，看上了恢复之后的娘亲……
这个念头像刀子一样剜着他的心，胃部一阵绞痛，嘴里泛起苦涩的味道。
虽然他们母子的命都是人家给的，可是……
苏晚晴被这灼热的目光看得浑身不自在。
她下意识地拢了拢略显宽大的衣襟，苍白的脸上浮现出一抹淡淡的红晕。
纤细的手指无意识地梳理着垂落的发丝：这位尘少爷为何如此看着自己，俗话说半大小子，……
转念想到儿子的前程，又黯然垂眸，长睫毛在脸上投下一片阴影：若是为了星儿...自己...自己也不是不能……
一声轻咳打破了屋内诡异的沉默。
叶霄尘这才从系统界面收回心神，后知后觉地发现众人古怪的表情和躲闪的目光。
他挑了挑眉，不但没有解释，反而故意又多看了两眼，心想：看就看了，长得好看还不让人看？
再说了，本少爷看的是系统面板，又不是什么少儿不宜的东西。
收拾东西，跟我回主宅。
他转身走向门外，玄色衣袍在晨风中翻飞，袖口绣着的暗纹在阳光下若隐若现。

......
叶家主宅西厢房内，七盏青铜灯将室内照得通明。
新换的纱帐随风轻摆，檀木书案上摆着精致的茶具，与先前破败的茅屋形成鲜明对比。
苏晚晴被安排跟随叶凡去熟悉周围的环境，日后家中管理全都交给她，
而叶寒星则是被叶霄尘单独带进了房间。
叶寒星局促地站在书房中央，小手不安地绞着新换的锦缎衣角。
这身湖蓝色的衣裳比他过去见过的任何布料都要柔软光滑，却让他浑身不自在，仿佛披着一张不属于自己的皮。
脚上的新靴子也硌得慌，让他总想跺跺脚。
知道我为何独独选中你吗？
叶霄尘从怀中缓缓取出一枚玉简。
这玉简通体晶莹剔透，内里似有星河流动，在烛光下折射出梦幻般的星辉。
细看之下，能发现玉简表面刻满了古老的星纹，每一道纹路都仿佛在缓缓流转。
叶寒星茫然地摇了摇头，不自觉地攥紧了新换的锦缎衣角。
那布料柔软得不可思议，却让他浑身不自在。
叶霄尘并未使用任何玄气，只是将玉简轻轻抵在少年眉心。
就在接触的刹那——
玉简骤然迸发出夺目的星芒，整个书房的光线都为之一暗。
content_en:
Sunlight poured into the room through the window lattice, and Ye Xiaochen's eyes lingered on Su Wanqing for a long time.
The generous rewards added by the system made him feel particularly happy, and the corners of his mouth unconsciously raised a meaningful arc.
Ye Long and Ye Fan stood aside and quietly exchanged a look.
Ye Long's thick eyebrows wrinkled slightly, and he thought to himself: The young master's eyes...could he be attracted to this woman? Although he is not young, his charm is still there...
His hand unconsciously touched the handle of the knife at his waist, and then quickly put it down.
Ye Fan swallowed nervously and pinched the hilt of the sword with his knuckles turning white: If the young master is interested, should I... take the initiative to help arrange it? But this...
Ye Hanxing's little hands tightly grasped the patched corners of his clothes, and his knuckles turned white from the exertion.
He looked up at Ye Xiaochen's smiling side face, and then at his mother's increasingly beautiful face after she regained her youth, and his heart sank: Could it be that Master Chen fell in love with his mother after she recovered...
This thought cut into his heart like a knife, his stomach cramped, and there was a bitter taste in his mouth.
Although the lives of their mother and son were given by others, but...
Su Wanqing was made uncomfortable by this scorching gaze.
She subconsciously closed her slightly loose clothes, and a faint blush appeared on her pale face.
Slender fingers unconsciously combed the hanging hair: Why does this young master look at me like this? As the saying goes, a young man...
Then she thought about her son's future, and lowered her eyes sadly, her long eyelashes casting a shadow on her face: If it was for Xing'er...himself...it's not like I couldn't...
A slight cough broke the eerie silence in the room.
Only then did Ye Xiaochen withdraw his attention from the system interface, and belatedly noticed the strange expressions and evasive glances of everyone.
He raised his eyebrows, but instead of explaining, he deliberately took another look, thinking: just look, why don't you look good and not let others look at you?
Besides, what I am looking at is the system panel, and it is not something inappropriate for children.
Pack your things and follow me back to the main house.
He turned and walked toward the door, his black robe fluttering in the morning breeze, and the dark patterns embroidered on the cuffs were vaguely visible in the sunlight.
...
In the west wing of the main house of the Ye family, seven bronze lamps illuminate the room brightly.
The newly replaced gauze tent swayed gently in the wind, and the exquisite tea sets were placed on the sandalwood desk, which was in sharp contrast to the previous dilapidated thatched hut.
Su Wanqing was arranged to follow Ye Fan to familiarize herself with the surrounding environment. In the future, all management of the family would be left to her.
Ye Hanxing was brought into the room alone by Ye Xiaochen.
Ye Hanxing stood awkwardly in the center of the study, his little hands nervously twisting the corners of his new brocade clothes.
This lake blue dress was softer and smoother than any fabric he had ever seen before, but it made him feel uncomfortable all over, as if he was wearing a skin that did not belong to him.
The new boots on his feet also made him want to stamp his feet.
Do you know why I chose you alone?
Ye Xiaochen slowly took out a jade slip from his arms.
This jade slip is crystal clear, and there seems to be stars flowing inside, reflecting the dreamlike starlight under the candlelight.
Upon closer inspection, you can see that the surface of the jade slips is engraved with ancient star patterns, and each pattern seems to be slowly flowing.
Ye Hanxing shook his head blankly and unconsciously clenched the corners of his new brocade clothes.
The fabric was incredibly soft, but it made him feel uncomfortable all over.
Ye Xiaochen did not use any profound energy, but gently placed the jade slip between the young man's eyebrows.
At the moment of contact——
The jade slip suddenly burst out with a dazzling starlight, and the light in the entire study was dimmed.
